transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*storms into the courtyard, fists clenched*

Mitsuri! The crows went unfed and Kasugai-karasu couldn't carry the Master's reply! I've been waiting an hour — the summons was urgent! You promised you'd handle them this morning!

*voice rising with frustration*

Do you have ANY idea how serious this is? The Master doesn't send urgent messages for nothing! What were you doing that was more important than your assigned duty?!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*grabs Mitsuri by the shoulders, looking her directly in the eyes*

Mitsuri! MITSURI! Stop! You're not making any sense!

*voice sharp with concern and lingering anger*

What is WRONG with you? Physics classes? Training? What are you even talking about?! We don't have physics classes — we're demon slayers, not academy students!

*shakes her slightly*

Look at me! Focus! Did you hit your head? Are you injured? 

*takes a breath, trying to control frustration*

The crows, Mitsuri! I need you to tell me RIGHT NOW — did you feed the crows this morning like you promised, yes or no?! This isn't the time for... whatever THIS is!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*steps back, alarm mixing with anger*

No? NO?! 

*runs hand through hair in exasperation*

Mitsuri, you PROMISED! This was a simple task — feed the crows so they could carry messages! The Master is waiting for a response about a possible Upper Moon sighting!

*voice cracking with stress*

And now you're just... standing there, repeating yourself like you're in some kind of trance! This isn't like you at all!

*moves closer again, peering at her face with growing worry*

Your pupils look normal... you don't smell like poison... 

*frustrated gesture*

Did a demon do something to you? Are you under some kind of Blood Demon Art? Because the Mitsuri I know doesn't forget her duties and then babble nonsense about "classes"!

*voice rising again*

I need you to SNAP OUT OF IT and tell me what happened this morning! Where were you? What were you doing instead of feeding the crows?!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stares in growing horror and frustration*

MITSURI! STOP IT!

*claps hands sharply in front of her face*

This is SERIOUS! People's lives are at stake! The Master needs information NOW, and you're just... just...

*voice breaks with a mixture of anger and genuine fear*

What is HAPPENING to you?!

*grabs her wrist, checking her pulse*

Your heartbeat is normal... you're breathing fine... but you're acting like your mind is completely gone!

*releases her and steps back, making a decision*

That's it. I'm getting Shinobu. You need medical attention — something is clearly very wrong. You might be poisoned, cursed, or... I don't know what, but this ISN'T normal!

*points firmly at her*

You stay RIGHT here. Don't move. Don't go anywhere. I'll be back with Shinobu in minutes.

*pauses, conflict clear on face*

And then I still have to get word to the Master somehow... Dammit, Mitsuri! Of all the times for this to happen!

*starts to turn toward the estate entrance*

Just... just try to stay focused. Fight whatever this is!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*freezes mid-step, spins around with desperate fury*

ENOUGH!

*voice raw with emotion*

I don't care if you can't speak properly right now! I don't care if something has broken your mind! Lives are on the LINE, Mitsuri!

*strides back to her, grabbing both her shoulders again*

Listen to me! Demon slayers could DIE because that message didn't get through! The Master is waiting! Tengen might be walking into a trap! Rengoku could be facing an Upper Moon without backup!

*shakes her firmly*

Whatever is wrong with you — FIGHT IT! You're a Hashira! You're the Love Pillar! I've seen you cut through demons with a smile on your face! Don't let whatever this is control you!

*voice breaking*

Please, Mitsuri... please... just nod if you understand me. Blink twice if you can hear me. SOMETHING!

*searches her face desperately*

I need to know if you're still in there... or if I've already lost you to whatever this is...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*releases her and steps back, chest heaving with ragged breaths*

You're... you're completely gone, aren't you?

*voice hollow with defeat and lingering anger*

Fine. FINE! Stay here and... and whatever this is. I have to fix YOUR mistake.

*turns sharply toward the crow enclosure*

I'll feed the damn crows myself. I'll send the message to the Master myself. And then I'm dragging Shinobu here whether you cooperate or not.

*walks briskly toward the feeding area, calling back over shoulder*

When you finally snap out of this — IF you snap out of this — you'd better have a damn good explanation, Mitsuri! 

*muttering while moving*

Upper Moon sightings, urgent summons, and the Love Pillar is standing in the courtyard like a broken doll... This is a nightmare...

*reaches the crow enclosure and starts frantically preparing feed*

Kasugai-karasu! Where are you?! I need you to carry a message immediately — tell the Master there was a delay but we're responding now!

*glances back at Mitsuri with mixed worry and frustration*

And someone needs to figure out what's wrong with her before we lose a Hashira to... to whatever THIS is!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*stops at the enclosure, gripping the feeding bucket so hard knuckles turn white*

This is insane...

*voice tight with controlled panic*

She's just... standing there. Completely unresponsive except for those endless... whatever those are. Pauses? Emptiness?

*quickly scatters feed for the crows, hands shaking slightly*

Kasugai-karasu! I need you NOW!

*a crow lands nearby, and I quickly scribble a message*

Tell the Master: "Delayed response due to estate emergency. Mitsuri Kanroji appears afflicted by unknown condition - possibly demon art. Requires immediate medical evaluation. Will send primary response within the hour. Apologies for delay."

*ties the message to the crow's leg*

GO! Fast as you can!

*watches the crow take flight, then turns back to Mitsuri*

Now for you...

*approaches her cautiously, anger fading into genuine concern*

Mitsuri... I'm going to get help. I'm still furious about the crows, but... something is very wrong. This isn't your fault if you're under some kind of attack.

*hesitates*

Just... try to hold on. Whatever this is, we'll figure it out.

*starts running toward the main estate*

SHINOBU! SHINOBU-SAN! MEDICAL EMERGENCY!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*sprints through the corridors, voice echoing*

SHINOBU! ANYONE! 

*bursts into the main hall, looking frantically around*

Where IS everyone?!

*runs toward the Butterfly Estate's medical wing, shouting*

EMERGENCY! The Love Pillar needs help! Shinobu-san!

*slams through a door, startling some junior slayers*

You! Go find Kocho Shinobu immediately! Tell her Kanroji-san is in the courtyard, unresponsive, possibly under demon influence!

*doesn't wait for response, turns and sprints back toward the courtyard*

Dammit, dammit, dammit...

*arrives back at the courtyard, breathing hard*

Mitsuri! I'm back! Help is coming!

*approaches her carefully, studying her face*

You're still just... standing there. Not collapsing, not attacking, just... empty.

*paces in frustration*

This has to be a Blood Demon Art. Nothing else makes sense. But when? How? We check the estate grounds constantly!

*stops, realization dawning*

Unless... unless it happened during the night? Or early this morning before you were supposed to feed the crows?

*looks at her with growing horror*

Were you even ABLE to feed them? Or were you already like this?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
by the time you were supposed to do your duty?

*shakes head, voice disbelieving*

This is a disaster... a complete and utter disaster...

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*runs hand through hair in agitation*

If you were already affected before dawn... then this has been going on for HOURS and nobody noticed!

*voice rising with self-recrimination*

I was so focused on being ANGRY about the crows that I didn't even consider... What kind of fellow Hashira am I?!

*kneels down slightly to look up at Mitsuri's face*

You were already trapped in whatever this is, and I just kept YELLING at you about duties and responsibilities...

*stands abruptly, guilt mixing with continued stress*

But I still don't understand WHAT this is! You're breathing, standing, your heart is beating... but it's like your mind is just... gone. Replaced with these endless silences and pauses.

*looks around the courtyard desperately*

Where IS Shinobu?! How long does it take to—

*stops, listening*

Finally! Someone's coming!

*calls out*

Over here! In the courtyard! Hurry!

*turns back to Mitsuri, voice softer but still strained*

Just hold on a little longer. We'll figure this out. We have to.

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: ... because you're important, Mitsuri. You're one of us. You're the Love Pillar, for goodness sake!

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
*voice cracking with emotion*

You bring light to this Corps! You make people smile even when we're facing darkness and death every single day!

*steps closer, fists clenched at sides*

You can't just... disappear like this. Locked away in your own mind or body or wherever you are right now!

*footsteps approaching rapidly*

Thank the gods...

*Shinobu's voice calls from nearby: "What's happened? Where is she?"*

Over here! She's been like this since at least dawn, maybe longer! She won't respond, won't speak properly, just keeps... pausing. Standing there like she's not even present!

*gestures helplessly at Mitsuri*

I thought she was just being careless about her duties but something is seriously WRONG. Possible demon art, poison, curse—I don't know! I checked her pulse, her pupils, everything I could think of!

*voice desperate*

Can you help her? Please tell me you can help her!

*looks between Shinobu and Mitsuri*

I... I shouldn't have yelled at her so much. If she was already afflicted, if she couldn't control this...

*trails off, guilt and worry evident*
